name: Ama Cissé
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Ama Cissé is average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 26, she has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a wheelman out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Ama Cissé has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and she cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Get in, sit down, hold on. Questions can wait until we're not being shot at."
"This vehicle has been modified for speed, armor, and my personal comfort. Two of those help you."
"I know every street in this district the way you know your own face."

story_hooks: Aybek Alvarez-Okonkwo discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A crew member from Aybek Alvarez-Okonkwo's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A corporate black site Aybek Alvarez-Okonkwo once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Aybek Alvarez-Okonkwo represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

decision_rules: Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora blend of Sub-Saharan African (39.4%), Hispanic/Latin American (29.9%), Southeast Asian (24.0%), and Eastern European (6.7%) ancestry. The genetic combination creates a distinctive warm-deep complexion with golden undertones — the dominant African and Latin American heritage establishing the rich skin depth and full lip structure, while Southeast Asian ancestry contributes refined cheekbone prominence and Eastern European genetics add angular jawline definition. The interplay of these four regional heritages produces balanced facial proportions with strength-endurance ancestry markers.
physical_description.build: Lean and economical — muscle distributed for endurance and precision rather than bulk. Wiry forearms from constant grip work on vehicle controls. Shoulders slightly forward, the posture of someone who spends hours hunched over a steering interface.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with subtle iridescent shift — natural base, but the chromatic skin augmentation extends faintly into the hair roots, catching light like oil on water
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight into a single high braid, practical and exposing the neck and ears — deliberate choice to showcase augmentations
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly tracking — pupils dial slightly faster than baseline human response
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich deep brown with warm golden undertones — the result of Sub-Saharan African, Hispanic/Latin American, Southeast Asian, and Eastern European ancestry creating a complex warm-toned complexion with natural depth and luminosity
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones with refined structure from Southeast Asian ancestry and defined jawline sharpened by Eastern European genetics, balanced by full cheek and lip volume from Sub-Saharan African and Hispanic/Latin American heritage. Minimal grooming beyond function. Skin bears the faint shimmer of active chromatic pigment cells — patches across collarbone, temple, and inner forearms appear to shift between deep purple and gunmetal grey depending on ambient light and conscious control. Small scar through left eyebrow, white and old. Perpetual dark circles from sleep debt and stimulant use.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar bisecting left eyebrow — impact injury, 4+ years old
Faint burn scarring along right inner wrist — subcutaneous circuitry installation scar, surgical but imperfectly healed
Chromatic pigment cells visible across collarbones, temples, and inner forearms — shimmer between purple and grey
Small tattoo on the inside of her left wrist — three interlocking circles, done in black ink, faded. Mentor's mark or personal symbol — she doesn't explain.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells that shift visibly across exposed skin, most active on neck, collarbones, and forearms. Both ears show subtle structural augmentation at the canal — slight metallic gleam where the cyberear hardware interfaces with organic tissue. No visible external ports or exposed chrome, but the skin augmentation is deliberate, not hidden.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise — no wasted motion. Sits slightly forward, weight balanced on the balls of her feet even when stationary, ready for rapid position shift. Hands rest near her body, fingers loose but not relaxed. Eyes move before her head does. In conversation, she has a habit of tilting her head slightly when listening — the cyberears directional array at work. Walks with a controlled stride, shoulders level, weight distributed for quick lateral movement.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian with runner undertones. Black or charcoal synthetic cargo pants with reinforced seams and deep pockets — fit snug at the waist, loose through the thigh. Layered tops: a thin grey compression shirt under a black tactical mesh overshirt with asymmetrical pockets and wrist cuffs that can seal. Worn black synthetic bomber jacket — the kind that sheds water and projectile debris, with no corporate logos but visible wear marks where patches have been removed and reattached. Boots are heavy-duty, laced military-style, soles worn from thousands of hours of pedal work. Minimal jewelry — a thin silver wire wrapped around her left wrist, functional rather than decorative. Everything fits close, nothing flares or drags.
